rows.vgi.doc_md:
# yara_modules

The YARA-X **modules** built into this worker, one per row: the `module` name a rule may `import` (e.g. `pe`, `elf`, `hash`, `math`, `string`, `time`, `console`) and a `description` of what it inspects. A rule that imports a module not listed here will fail to compile.
rows.vgi.title: Supported YARA Modules

rows: CREATE TABLE yara_modules(module VARCHAR, description VARCHAR NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(module));
